user_saw: A Mattermost slash command disappeared when OpenClaw tried to repair it and could not read the response body after Mattermost deleted it.
summary: The fix skips reading the body of a successful Mattermost slash-command DELETE so registration can recreate the command after a failed update.
reasoning: The fix’s test shows that a failed update followed by a successful DELETE with an unreadable body prevented OpenClaw from sending the replacement POST. The delete-and-recreate fallback and the client’s success-body parsing both predate the July 1 shallow boundary, and the available older history did not establish when they first interacted this way.
